youtube_title: Blocked Nose Only At Night? Here's Why | Body Fix #28 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #28. Nose fine all day, but BLOCKED the moment you lie down?
B is right. Raise your head. Lying flat lets mucus pool in the nose.
Lying down sends more blood flow to the nose and mucus settles. Blocked.
Fix: Extra pillow, warm shower before bed, saline spray, clean bedding.
Red flags: Blocked over 3 WEEKS, face pain + fever, or bleeding? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Common cold / sinusitis
